text.en:
4228
OFFICIAL GAZETTE
of Julita and northeast of barrio of Potong in the municipaïity of
Burauen. (The data used are those shown in map of the munic-
ipality of Burauen, showing the proposed boundaries of the proposed
boundary of Julita, Province of Leyte, scale 1:50,000, sigred by
Demetrio Resurreccion, chief of survey party No. 12-A.)
The municipality of Julita, as herein created, contains
the following barrios: Julita, which is the seat of the
municipal government, Anibong, Aslom, Bungdo, Hindang,
Calbasag, San Pablo, San Andres, Caridad, Santo Niño, :
Alegria, Tagkip, Tolosahay and Posod.
The municipality of Burauen shall have its present
territory minus the portion thereof included in the munic-
ipality of Julita.
The municipality of Julita, as herein created, shall begin
to exist upon the appointment and qualification of the
mayor, vice-mayor, and a majority of the councilors there-
of, but in no case earlier than November 15, 1919.
.
Done in the City of Manila, this 10th day of October,
in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and forty-
nine, and of the Independence of the Philippines, the
ELPIDIO QUIRINO
President of the Philippines
By the President:
TEODORO EVANGELISTA
Executive Secretary
